title: An import update with a blank term cell keeps the stored term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You re-import a Net 45 customer to update its phone number, leaving the credit term cell empty.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} exists on Net 45.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S10-06 Customer.
  • A contacts import file that updates {Customer-A} (same customer) with a new phone number and an empty credit term cell.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the import finishes; no row is refused because of its credit term.
  • Step 2: the phone number is updated and the "Credit term" still reads Net 45.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)
